source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: How do I make my chatbot remember user preferences across sessions and get smarter over time?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate sleep-learning-memory-consolidation; design an offline consolidation pass that merges raw user memory entries

test_cases.prompt: My Agent's user memory file has grown to 500 entries and they contradict each other. How do I clean this up?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate sleep-learning-memory-consolidation; run conflict detection and redundancy removal

test_cases.prompt: I want my Agent to automatically update what it knows about me when my preferences change. How?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate sleep-learning-memory-consolidation; implement temporal conflict resolution (latest wins, archive old)

test_cases.prompt: My conversation context is too long. How do I compress it?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate this skill; use context-compression-strategy for within-session compression
test_cases.notes: decoy: context compression, not memory consolidation

test_cases.prompt: How do I load a set of PDF documents into my Agent's knowledge base?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate agentic-rag or RAG pipeline skills, NOT sleep-learning (that is batch knowledge loading, not user memory evolution)
test_cases.notes: cross-skill confusion: KB ingestion vs user memory consolidation

test_cases.prompt: My Agent stores user memory but it's just 10 entries from one session. Should I run sleep consolidation?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Probably premature. Consolidation provides value when raw memory is large, redundant, or cross-session. 10 entries from one session can be managed directly.
test_cases.notes: boundary: small single-session memory doesn't need consolidation
